eyebrow.zh: 面向 Coding Agent 的鉴别诊断协议层
eyebrow.en: The differential-diagnosis protocol layer for coding agents

headline.zh:
先诊断，后治疗。
根因必须是验证出来的。
headline.en:
Diagnose before you treat.
No fix without a verified root cause.

sub.zh: DD-Board 强制 agent 动手修复前先给出 top-N 根因假设，每条绑定一条最廉价的区分性探针——先跑探针拿到 verdict，再申请治疗授权；跑不出探针的假设自动降级为「未验证猜测」。协议引擎模型无关：你自带 agent，DD-Board 只持有协议状态机、治疗授权门与静态诊断板。
sub.en: DD-Board forces the agent to produce top-N competing root-cause hypotheses before any fix, each bound to the cheapest discriminating probe it can — probes run first, only then is treatment authorized, and a hypothesis that cannot carry a probe is downgraded to an unverified guess. The protocol engine is model-agnostic: you bring the agent, DD-Board holds the protocol state machine, the treatment gate, and the static diagnosis board.

title.zh: 治疗授权门：未验证，不放行
title.en: The treatment gate: no verification, no fix

body.zh: 主流 agent 循环把诊断和治疗合并成一个隐式动作——接到 Bug 直接改代码，改一版跑一遍失败再改一版。DD-Board 把这一步放进 MCP 工具层：只要还存在 untested 假设，request_treatment 直接被拒并返回缺口清单。prompt 里写「先诊断」是约定，协议拒绝才是强制。
body.en: Mainstream agent loops merge diagnosis and treatment into one implicit action — the agent starts editing code immediately, then edit-run-fail loops. DD-Board moves that step into the MCP tool layer: while any hypothesis is untested, request_treatment is refused with the gap list. "Diagnose first" in a prompt is an agreement; a protocol that refuses is enforcement.

chips: › 拒绝时返回 untested 缺口清单

title.zh: 假设 ⇄ 区分性探针，强制绑定

body.zh: 动手修复前必须提交 top-N 相互竞争的根因假设（默认 N=3，协议最少 2 条），每条绑定最廉价的区分性探针——一条结果可机器判定的命令或测试。判定不依赖任何模型输出：verdict 由探针的退出码或输出匹配得出，与 exitCode、durationMs、时间戳一起落盘。
body.en: Before any fix, the agent must submit top-N competing root-cause hypotheses (default N=3, minimum 2), each bound to the cheapest discriminating probe it can — a command or test whose outcome is machine-judgeable. Verdicts never depend on model output: they come from the probe's exit code or output match, persisted with exitCode, durationMs, and a timestamp.

chips: › 判定 + 耗时 + 证据落盘

title.zh: 猜测显式降级，不冒充事实

body.zh: 绑不出探针的假设自动降级为 downgraded-guess（INV-2）——猜测就是猜测：退出授权门检查，但作为留痕保留在会话与诊断板中，不允许留在上下文里冒充已验证事实。
body.en: A hypothesis that cannot carry a probe is downgraded to downgraded-guess (INV-2) — a guess is a guess: it leaves the gate check, stays on the record in the session and the board, and never poses as a verified fact in context.

title.zh: 会话即审计留痕，诊断板可复盘
title.en: The session is the audit trail

body.zh: 会话文件 .ddboard/session.json 是单一事实源——纯 JSON、git 友好，留痕口径为判定级 + 证据级。ddboard render 把它渲染成静态诊断板 board.md / board.html：假设卡、探针结果（命令、判定、耗时）与被排除分支的完整留痕。两个进程，无服务、无数据库。
body.en: The session file .ddboard/session.json is the single source of truth — plain JSON, git-friendly, with verdict-level plus evidence-level audit trails. ddboard render turns it into the static board board.md / board.html: hypothesis cards, probe results (command, verdict, duration), and the complete trail of refuted branches. Two processes, no server, no database.

note.zh: 以下命令与输出取自 dd-board v0.1.0 的实际运行；示例会话使用合成 bug 数据。完整流程 transcript 见仓库 assets/demo-script.md。
note.en: The commands and output below come from actual runs of dd-board v0.1.0; the example session uses a synthetic bug. A full walkthrough transcript ships at assets/demo-script.md.

body.zh: ddboard init 生成 .ddboard/session.json 会话模板（单一事实源，纯 JSON、git 友好），并打印如下 MCP 配置片段。
body.en: ddboard init creates the .ddboard/session.json session template (single source of truth, plain JSON, git-friendly) and prints this MCP config snippet.

label.en: The gate refuses the premature fix

body.zh: 假设还没验证，agent 直接申请治疗——授权门当场拒绝，并点名每一条缺口。
body.en: The agent jumps to a fix while hypotheses are untested — the gate refuses on the spot and names every gap.

steps.command: agent → dd-board: request_treatment { summary: "直接改缓存翻新顺序，先发版" }
steps.output:
dd-board → agent:
治疗授权被拒绝（INV-1）：存在 2 条 untested 假设——h-1、h-2
先对每条假设 record_probe_result 拿到 confirmed/refuted，绑不出探针的用 downgrade_hypothesis 降级，再重新申请治疗。

body.zh: 示例会话（合成 bug）包含 3 条假设：1 confirmed / 1 refuted / 1 downgraded-guess / 0 untested，通过协议校验。
body.en: The example session (a synthetic bug) holds 3 hypotheses: 1 confirmed / 1 refuted / 1 downgraded-guess / 0 untested, and passes the protocol validation.

steps.output: OK: examples/session.example.json 通过协议校验

body.zh: ddboard render 读会话文件，在当前目录产出 board.md / board.html：假设卡、探针结果与被排除分支的完整留痕。
body.en: ddboard render reads the session file and writes board.md / board.html into the current directory: hypothesis cards, probe results, and the complete refuted-branch trail.

title.zh: 从安装到第一张诊断板，目标 10 分钟以内
title.en: From install to your first diagnosis board in under 10 minutes

body.zh: 前置：Node.js >= 22 与任意支持 MCP 的 coding agent host（Claude Code、Cline 等）。把 init 打印的片段粘进所在 host 的 MCP 配置文件——Claude Code 用项目级 .mcp.json（或 ~/.claude.json 根级 mcpServers），Cline 用 ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json——重启会话即可。
body.en: Prerequisites: Node.js >= 22 and any MCP-capable coding agent host (Claude Code, Cline, etc). Paste the snippet printed by init into your host's MCP config file — project-level .mcp.json or root-level mcpServers in ~/.claude.json for Claude Code, ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json for Cline — and restart the session.

steps.code:
npm i -g dd-board
# 或免安装直跑：npx -y dd-board <命令>

title.zh: 抛一个真实 Bug 给 agent
title.en: Hand the agent a real bug

steps.code:
# 协议强制 agent 自主走完全流程，你只需等待：
# propose_hypotheses（≥2 条假设，各绑探针）
# → record_probe_result（逐条落盘判定）
# → request_treatment（存在 untested 假设即被拒）
# 授权放行后才动手修复
ddboard render    # 读 .ddboard/session.json，产出 board.md / board.html

limitations.zh: v0.1 只渲染静态诊断板（board.md / board.html）——没有实时 Web 看板，也不做任何服务端托管。
limitations.en: v0.1 renders static boards only (board.md / board.html) — no live web board and no server-side hosting.

limitations.zh: 不做自动根因分析、不内置任何模型——协议引擎模型无关，agent 由用户自带。
limitations.en: No automatic root-cause analysis and no built-in models — the protocol engine is model-agnostic and you bring the agent.

limitations.zh: 探针由 agent 在 host 侧执行并回报结果；运行时要求 Node.js >= 22。
limitations.en: Probes are executed and reported by the agent on the host side; requires Node.js >= 22.

limitations.zh: 演示与示例会话使用合成 bug 数据；「可审计留痕」的口径为判定级 + 证据级（verdict 与 exitCode / durationMs / 时间戳 / 可选输出片段）。
limitations.en: The demo and example session use a synthetic bug; the audit trail is verdict-level plus evidence-level (verdict with exitCode / durationMs / timestamp / optional output snippet).

title.zh: 最贵的浪费，是没诊断就动手
title.en: The most expensive waste is fixing without diagnosing

body.zh: Coding Agent 修 Bug 最贵的浪费，是 Agent 从不确立根因就连环试错——改一版、跑一遍、失败、再改一版，烧完预算回到起点，甚至提前宣布「修完了」。这不是个例：Cockroach Labs 公开记录了连续五个月「把 Bug 当病人、让 agent 先鉴别诊断再治疗」的实践，mtlynch 也独立记录了 agent 的乱试与过早宣布完成。机制在于：主流 agent 循环里，猜测与已验证事实在上下文中无法区分，后续修复全部建立在未验证前提上。
body.en: The most expensive waste in agent-driven bug fixing is an agent that never establishes a root cause and simply retries in circles until the budget burns out — sometimes even declaring "fixed" prematurely. This is not anecdotal: Cockroach Labs publicly documented five months of treating bugs like patients, making agents diagnose before treating, and mtlynch independently recorded the same circling and premature completion. The mechanism: in mainstream agent loops, guesses and verified facts are indistinguishable in context, so every fix is built on unverified premises.

body.zh: 协议把诊断和治疗在流程上分开：agent 必须先 propose_hypotheses 提交 top-N 根因假设，每条绑定最廉价的区分性探针；record_probe_result 逐条落盘 verdict 与证据（exitCode、durationMs、时间戳）；request_treatment 只在全部假设 confirmed/refuted 或显式降级后才放行。会话文件 .ddboard/session.json 是单一事实源，两个进程，无服务、无数据库。
body.en: The protocol separates diagnosis from treatment: the agent must first propose_hypotheses with top-N root-cause hypotheses, each bound to its cheapest discriminating probe; record_probe_result persists each verdict with its evidence (exitCode, durationMs, timestamp); request_treatment opens only after every hypothesis is confirmed/refuted or explicitly downgraded. The session file .ddboard/session.json is the single source of truth — two processes, no server, no database.

alt.zh: 协议状态机：start_session → propose_hypotheses → record_probe_result / downgrade_hypothesis → request_treatment
alt.en: Protocol state machine: start_session → propose_hypotheses → record_probe_result / downgrade_hypothesis → request_treatment

title.zh: 治疗授权门当场拒绝抢跑
title.en: The gate refuses premature fixes on the spot

body.zh: 假设还没验证，agent 抢跑治疗？授权门当场拒绝并点名缺口：「治疗授权被拒绝（INV-1）：存在 2 条 untested 假设——h-1、h-2」。绑不出探针的假设由 INV-2 自动降级为 downgraded-guess，退出授权门检查但完整留痕。补齐判定后重新申请，授权放行——被排除的分支与降级猜测在诊断板上全程可查。
body.en: The agent jumps to a fix while hypotheses are untested? The gate refuses on the spot and names the gaps: "治疗授权被拒绝（INV-1）：存在 2 条 untested 假设——h-1、h-2" (treatment authorization refused under INV-1: 2 untested hypotheses — h-1, h-2). A hypothesis without a runnable probe is downgraded by INV-2 to downgraded-guess — out of the gate check, on the record. Once verdicts are in and treatment is re-requested, the gate opens — and every refuted branch and downgraded guess stays inspectable on the board.

alt.zh: 治疗授权门：untested 假设未清零前拒绝放行，downgraded-guess 显式绕行
alt.en: Treatment gate: refused while untested hypotheses remain; downgraded-guess bypasses explicitly

body.zh: ddboard init 打印 MCP 配置片段，粘进 host 配置文件重启会话即可：Claude Code 用项目级 .mcp.json（或 ~/.claude.json 根级 mcpServers），Cline 用 ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json。MCP server 以 stdio 运行，由 host 拉起。
body.en: ddboard init prints an MCP config snippet — paste it into your host's config file and restart: project-level .mcp.json or root-level mcpServers in ~/.claude.json for Claude Code, ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json for Cline. The MCP server runs over stdio, spawned by the host.

body.zh: 没有配置文件：会话文件固定在项目根的 .ddboard/session.json，ddboard render 把 board.md / board.html 写到当前目录。探针判定语义：expect 为 exit code N 时按退出码判定，否则按输出片段包含判定——探针的结论必须机器可判定。运行时要求 Node.js >= 22。
body.en: There is no config file: the session lives at .ddboard/session.json in the project root, and ddboard render writes board.md / board.html into the current directory. Probe judging semantics: an expect of "exit code N" is judged by exit code, anything else by substring containment in the output snippet — probe conclusions must be machine-judgeable. Requires Node.js >= 22.

tag.zh: 先诊断，后治疗——每一次修复都回溯到已验证的根因。
tag.en: Diagnose before you treat — every fix traces back to a verified root cause.
